description: Read the app's moderation log, newest first: who named or removed a moderator (of the app or of a room), each ban, every room message, inbox message or community entry someone other than its author took down. Each line: { kind, by ("dev:<email>" or a moderator's per-app user id), target, room?, detail?, at }. `on` says whether the app keeps the log; it is off by default (neblla_update_app moderationLog: true).
name: neblla_get_moderation_log
